verdict.rationale: Belvo documents its API through an OpenAPI spec page and offers a first-party Enrichment API (Incomes, Recurring Expenses, Risk Insights, Employment Metrics). That enrichment is the kind of derived signal an automated financial workflow can reason over, and a community commenter called the API "very clean." The evidence never explicitly confirms structured JSON responses or field-level schemas, and the probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI file at the standard paths, so agent-consumability is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit JSON response format documentation, field-level schema and enrichment output definitions, a downloadable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration that data parses without heuristics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the data comes back agent-consumable — clean structured JSON, documented schemas, and enrichment an automated financial workflow can reason over without heuristic parsing
